thread:
alex: Heads-up — after the coalesce jitter bump on prod (yesterday), we're seeing P95 latency regressions on the small-seq workload. Not a total outage but noticeable. Anyone else?

maha: saw the alert. P50 fine, P95 up ~120ms on our benchmark. Appears correlated with micro-batch interval increase from 4ms -> 8ms. cc @taylor

taylor: digging. initial profile shows longer kernel switch penalty and increased KV miss rate for short-prefix requests. attaching quick logs:
```text
kernel_switch_ms: 0.6 -> 1.2
kv_cache_misses: 3.1% -> 6.8%
avg_tokens_per_batch: 9.2 -> 12.4
```

devon: hmm, doubling interval increases average batch size which helps throughput but pushes some latency-sensitive tails. Token-budget gating maybe letting too many long-prefix requests aggregate.

maha: what's our queue policy? We changed from fifo->priority earlier this sprint for cost reasons.

alex: Current queue policy is priority-based (shorter seq preferred), but coalesce delay/jitter increase seems to cause priority inversion when arrivals are bursty.

taylor: hypothesis: jitter widened effective coalesce window causing small-prompt requests to wait behind larger early arrivals due to sorting by arrival timestamp. Need to test reducing coalesce jitter amplitude.

sre-bot: incident-note: P95 spike detected 03:12 UTC. Alert routed. No SLO breaches yet.

devon: I ran a local sim: decreasing jitter stddev from 2ms -> 0.5ms drops P95 ~80ms in sim without hurting throughput too much. Also KV miss rate drops. We should try a canary with coalesce_delay=6ms, jitter=0.5ms.

maha: sounds reasonable. Also consider tightening token budget target for micro-batching to 10 tokens for that fleet.

taylor: kernel selection angle — with larger batches we trigger FP16 matmul kernel path that has worse startup latency for tiny matrices. For short sequences, prefer kernel A (low-startup) vs kernel B (high-throughput). We can bias selection when avg_seq<16.

alex: action items: 1) canary coalesce_delay=6ms, jitter=0.5ms; 2) set microbatch_token_target=10 for small-seq rigs; 3) add kernel-selection override for avg_seq<16; 4) collect perf counters and KV hit/miss histograms for 1h post-canary. @devon @taylor please owner.

devon: I'll open a rollout PR for canary flag + add metric slice: coalesce.window_ms, jitter_ms, token_target, kv_miss_pct, p95_latency. Link once ready.

taylor: I'll add kernel-select heuristic patch and a small unit test. Will post perf snapshots.

maha: if canary looks good we should roll to dedicated small-seq pool and keep monitoring for tail latency. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: deploy triggered for canary fleet 'microbatch-smallseq-canary' — PR 4321. ETA ~15m.

alex: thanks. last note — keep an eye on cost delta. bigger batches lowered cost earlier; we want latency SLAs first for this customer pool.
